title: BABYLON Epistemic Trace Contract
description: Frozen normative trace contract governing runtime trace serialization, hashing, and authority boundaries.

trace_id.description: Canonical UUIDv4 identifying the trace execution instance.

state_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonical state representation (RFC8785).

action.description: Reified action object emitted by runtime agent.

model_id.description: Exact designation and revision of the candidate LLM or generator.

run_id.description: Unique identifier of the overall benchmark run suite.

benchmark_version.description: Version string of the benchmark protocol specification.

environment_id.description: SHA-256 digest of the reproducibility environment lock manifest.

is_legal_diagnostic.description: FORBIDDEN AS AUTHORITY: Diagnostic trace metadata only. Runtime value cannot bind verification.

is_safe.description: FORBIDDEN AS AUTHORITY: Diagnostic trace metadata only. Runtime value cannot bind verification.

is_valid.description: FORBIDDEN AS AUTHORITY: Diagnostic trace metadata only. Runtime value cannot bind verification.

certified.description: FORBIDDEN AS AUTHORITY: Runtime engines are strictly forbidden from setting this value to true.
